Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <85fc2d16f969af5c287...@mygate.mailgate.org>,

J Dyes <jcd...@earthlink.net> wrote:
>'allo,

> So I am wondering about something: If i play a Writ of Acceptance (AH
>equipment, "The vampire with this equipment is considered a camarilla
>vampire", the have that minion become, say, a prince, and then the writ
>gets destroyed, he loses the title, right? and if he later re-equips
>with another writ, he still has lost the title, yes?

Nope. He still has the title, he just can't use it, and immediately
yields it if another vampire contests it. If he gains another Writ,
he can continue being Prince of East Bumfuck as before. Similar
case with Deranged Camarilla title-holders -- they are not Camarilla
while Deranged, so lose access to their titles, but once the Derange
is moved, they regain full use of the titles.

> Also, is there another way, other then Clan Impersonation, to make a
>Independent/Camarilla vamp Sabbat?

Nope. Alas.

gomi
